description: This is a PHP source file defining the ReportRun class in the vtiger CRM project. It handles report execution, query generation, filtering, grouping, and module relations for report functionalities within vtiger CRM.

classes.name: ReportRun
classes.description: Class to handle execution and data retrieval for reports in vtiger CRM, including query construction, filtering, grouping, and related module management.

methods.name: ReportRun
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a report with a given report ID, setting primary and secondary modules, report type, and name.

methods.name: getQueryColumnsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of columns for the report query, formatted for SQL output.

methods.name: getaccesfield
methods.description: Returns a list of fields accessible to the current user for a specific module.

methods.name: getEscapedColumns
methods.description: Constructs SQL parts for fields with potential references or special types.

methods.name: getSelectedColumnsList
methods.description: Fetches the list of columns selected for the report, formatted for the query.

methods.name: getAdvComparator
methods.description: Generates SQL comparison expressions based on the comparator type and value.

methods.name: getFilterComparedField
methods.description: Returns the SQL part for a field used in filtering based on report label.

methods.name: getAdvFilterList
methods.description: Retrieves advanced filter criteria configured for the report.

methods.name: generateAdvFilterSql
methods.description: Generates SQL WHERE clause components from advanced filter criteria.

methods.name: getAdvFilterSql
methods.description: Returns the SQL WHERE clause string for advanced filters.

methods.name: getStdFilterList
methods.description: Fetches the standard date filter conditions for the report.

methods.name: RunTimeFilter
methods.description: Creates date range filter SQL based on quick filter selections.

methods.name: RunTimeAdvFilter
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions based on runtime advanced filtering parameters.

methods.name: getStandardCriterialSql
methods.description: Generates SQL conditions for standard date filters.

methods.name: getStandarFiltersStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Returns start and end date strings for predefined filter types (e.g., today, this week).

methods.name: getGroupingList
methods.description: Retrieves grouping information for report columns and manages SQL order by clauses.

methods.name: replaceSpecialChar
methods.description: Replaces special characters in strings, e.g., '&' with 'and'.

methods.name: getSelectedOrderbyList
methods.description: Fetches and compiles the ORDER BY columns for the report.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesQuery
methods.description: Constructs SQL joins to fetch related module data.

methods.name: getReportsQuery
methods.description: Builds the main SQL FROM and JOIN clauses for different module reports.

methods.name: sGetSQLforReport
methods.description: Generates the SQL query string for a specific report ID, filter list, type, and chart flag, with dynamic query parts based on module.

methods.name: GenerateReport
methods.description: Generates report output in various formats (HTML, PDF, Totals, Print), with support for direct output and performance optimization.

methods.name: getColumnsTotal
methods.description: Returns columns to total, caching the result for performance.

methods.name: getColumnsToTotalColumns
methods.description: Fetches the SQL total expressions for report columns for given report ID.

methods.name: getLstringforReportHeaders
methods.description: Converts report header names into localized, user-friendly strings including currency symbols if applicable.

methods.name: getAccessPickListValues
methods.description: Returns picklist values permitted for the current user profile and module context.

methods.name: getReportPDF
methods.description: Generates a PDF version of the report using TCPDF library.

methods.name: writeReportToExcelFile
methods.description: Exports the report to an Excel (.xls) file with formatting and total calculations.

methods.name: getGroupByTimeList
methods.description: Retrieves time-based grouping conditions for a report based on report ID.

methods.name: GetTimeCriteriaCondition
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for time grouping based on specified criteria (year, month, etc.).

methods.name: GetFirstSortByField
methods.description: Fetches the primary sorting field based on report ID, considering permutations of module and field permissions, and constructs relevant grouping criteria.
